description: Airport Overlay Districts is a dataset listed in Town of Morrisville Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Town of Morrisville. The Airport Overlay Districts are intended to ensure the safety and welfare of the community from danger from falling aircraft and the annoyance and potential adverse health impacts of aircraft noise, and to ensure that development within the districts is compatible with activities associated with air traffic and services associated with the airport. Coverage: Morrisville, North Carolina. The portal files it under Planning and Permits. Its keywords are airport, overlay, district. The portal shows 2 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2022-07-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-townofmorrisville-org-portal.
